questions.stem: Which word best describes how likely this is? You will roll a number less than 7 on a standard dice.
worked: The faces of a standard dice are 1 to 6, so every roll is less than 7.
Something that must happen is certain.

questions.stem: Which word best describes how likely this is? You will roll a 7 on a standard dice.
worked: The faces of a standard dice are 1 to 6, so a 7 cannot happen.
Something that cannot happen is impossible.

questions.stem: Which word best describes how likely this is? You pick a card that is not a heart from a standard pack.
worked: There are 52 cards and 13 are hearts, so 39 are not hearts.
39 out of 52 is more than half but not all of them, so it is likely.

questions.stem: Which word best describes how likely this is? You will flip heads on a fair coin.
worked: A fair coin has 2 equally likely outcomes, and heads is 1 of them.
1 out of 2 is an even chance.

questions.stem: Which word best describes how likely this is? A randomly chosen month starts with J.
worked: January, June and July start with J: 3 of the 12 months.
3 out of 12 is less than half, so it is unlikely.

questions.stem: Which word best describes how likely this is? You pick a red card from a standard pack.
worked: Half the cards in a standard pack are red: 26 of 52.
Half is an even chance.

questions.stem: Which word best describes how likely this is? You roll an even number on a dice.
worked: 2, 4 and 6 are even: 3 of the 6 faces.
3 out of 6 is a half, an even chance.

questions.stem: Which word best describes how likely this is? You flip two fair coins and get two heads.
worked: Two fair coins give 4 equally likely outcomes: HH, HT, TH and TT. Two heads is 1 of them.
1 out of 4 is less than half, so it is unlikely.

questions.stem: Which word best describes how likely this is? You roll a number greater than 2 on a dice.
worked: The numbers greater than 2 are 3, 4, 5 and 6: 4 of the 6 faces.
4 out of 6 is more than half but not all, so it is likely.

questions.stem: Which word best describes how likely this is? A randomly chosen month has fewer than 32 days.
worked: No month has more than 31 days, so every month has fewer than 32.
Something that must happen is certain.

questions.stem: A fair dice is rolled. Write down the probability of rolling a 6. Give your answer as a fraction.
worked: There is 1 favourable outcome out of 6 equally likely outcomes, so \(P = \frac{1}{6}\).

questions.stem: A bag contains 3 red counters and 7 blue counters. A counter is taken at random. Write down the probability that the counter is red. Give your answer as a fraction.
worked: There are 3 favourable outcomes out of 10 equally likely outcomes, so \(P = \frac{3}{10}\).

questions.stem: A fair coin is flipped. Write down the probability of getting tails. Give your answer as a fraction.
worked: There is 1 favourable outcome out of 2 equally likely outcomes, so \(P = \frac{1}{2}\).

questions.stem: Five cards show the letters A, B, C, D and E. A card is taken at random. Write down the probability that the letter is a vowel. Give your answer as a fraction.
worked: There are 2 favourable outcomes out of 5 equally likely outcomes, so \(P = \frac{2}{5}\).

questions.stem: A fair dice is rolled. Write down the probability of rolling a number less than 3. Give your answer as a fraction.
worked: There are 2 favourable outcomes out of 6 equally likely outcomes, so \(P = \frac{2}{6} = \frac{1}{3}\).

questions.stem: A bag contains 4 red counters and 6 blue counters. A counter is taken at random. Write down the probability that the counter is blue. Give your answer as a fraction.
worked: There are 6 favourable outcomes out of 10 equally likely outcomes, so \(P = \frac{6}{10} = \frac{3}{5}\).

questions.stem: A fair dice is rolled. Write down the probability of rolling an odd number. Give your answer as a fraction.
worked: There are 3 favourable outcomes out of 6 equally likely outcomes, so \(P = \frac{3}{6} = \frac{1}{2}\).

worked: There are 13 favourable outcomes out of 52 equally likely outcomes, so \(P = \frac{13}{52} = \frac{1}{4}\).

worked: There are 2 favourable outcomes out of 6 equally likely outcomes, so \(P = \frac{2}{6} = \frac{1}{3}\).

questions.stem: A card is taken at random from a pack of 52 playing cards. Write down the probability that the card is a picture card (J, Q or K). Give your answer as a fraction.
worked: There are 12 favourable outcomes out of 52 equally likely outcomes, so \(P = \frac{12}{52} = \frac{3}{13}\).

questions.stem: A fair dice is rolled. Write down the probability of rolling a prime number. Give your answer as a fraction.
worked: There are 3 favourable outcomes out of 6 equally likely outcomes, so \(P = \frac{3}{6} = \frac{1}{2}\).

questions.stem: A bag contains 8 red counters and 2 yellow counters. A counter is taken at random. Write down the probability that the counter is yellow. Give your answer as a fraction.
worked: There are 2 favourable outcomes out of 10 equally likely outcomes, so \(P = \frac{2}{10} = \frac{1}{5}\).

questions.stem: A fair dice is rolled. Write down the probability of rolling a square number. Give your answer as a fraction.
worked: There are 2 favourable outcomes out of 6 equally likely outcomes, so \(P = \frac{2}{6} = \frac{1}{3}\).

questions.stem: A number is chosen at random from 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8. Write down the probability that the number is even. Give your answer as a fraction.
worked: There are 4 favourable outcomes out of 8 equally likely outcomes, so \(P = \frac{4}{8} = \frac{1}{2}\).

questions.stem: A letter is chosen at random from the word MATHS. Write down the probability that the letter is also in the word GAMES. Give your answer as a fraction.
worked: There are 3 favourable outcomes out of 5 equally likely outcomes, so \(P = \frac{3}{5}\).

It can never be negative or greater than 1.
The answer: P(event) is always between 0 and 1 inclusive.
